schema: CREATE TABLE "Employees" ("emp_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "emp_name" TEXT(100), "birth_date" TEXT(50));
correct_query: SELECT emp_name FROM Employees WHERE CAST((JULIANDAY('2024-01-01 00:00:00') - JULIANDAY(birth_date)) AS REAL) / 365 >= 30

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Computes calendar age using STRFTIME('%Y') and month-day adjustment instead of JULIANDAY difference divided by 365, diverging on leap-year drift boundary dates
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT emp_name FROM Employees WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', '2024-01-01 00:00:00') - STRFTIME('%Y', birth_date) - (STRFTIME('%m-%d', '2024-01-01 00:00:00') < STRFTIME('%m-%d', birth_date)) >= 30

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Computes unadjusted year difference STRFTIME('%Y') - STRFTIME('%Y') without accounting for days within the year
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT emp_name FROM Employees WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', '2024-01-01 00:00:00') - STRFTIME('%Y', birth_date) >= 30
